sources.excerpt: Cherry Pop Published on December 1, 2008 Devi Ever FX fuzz pedal Information Devi Ever The Devi Ever Cherry Pop Fuzz Guitar Effects Pedal has a thick fuzz sound and plenty of output. The Cherry Pop fuzz pedal also adds lots of sustain. With the volume, tone, and control knobs on the Cherry Pop pedal you get lots of tone shaping power. The control knob lets you dial in the thickness of fuzz you want. Operates on a 9-volt battery or external power supply (not included).
